title: Catalytic engineering of a cerium vanadate–bismuth vanadate system to yield a bifunctional photocatalyst for simultaneous hydrogen generation and pollutant degradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29439-29452
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04077A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jil Rose Perutil, Mathew K. Francis, Manish Verma, Neena S. John
The CV–BV heterojunction photocatalyst enables simultaneous hydrogen evolution (1011 μmol h−1 g−1) and 98% methyl orange degradation via an S-scheme mechanism demonstrating considerable potential for fuel generation from wastewater with remediation.
